protocol: PROTOCOL_V3.md Addendum J (round 4), rule 2; in sample only (2013-2021 frames, trades 2014-2021)

judge_frozen.name: FX weekend overreaction fade (G10 basket)
judge_frozen.why:
P = 0.10 (in sample) x 0.28 (VAL given an in-sample pass) = 2.8 %. Correlation with the account about 0.03, q 0.81. It ranks above the DAX pick despite a lower P because it is nearly independent: a newcomer must beat 2.02 x its correlation with the account to add anything.

SUB-SCORES (0-10):
- prior 3
- trades 8: about 100 a year, about 830 in 2014-2021 on about 350 distinct Mondays
- independence 10: no FX sleeve, and a Sunday-evening-to-Monday clock
- cost 6: needs about 6-7 bp gross per trade (about 0.10 R) against 0.64-1.92 bp all-in plus the Sunday spread shape, about 3x
- simplicity 9
- MQL5/FP 9: uses only the pair's own M1/D1 bars and the server clock; 0.01 lot at a 1 x ATR(20) stop risks 0.6-0.8 % of 1,000 EUR

RECORD:
- Never tested on currencies. results/r2/fx/summary_table.csv holds only A1-A4, B1-B3 and the B1 neighbours; r2/tracks/fx/descB.py has no weekend logic.
- Gold's weekend-gap fade is a different market, with a weekend drift of its own: meanrev #14, n 99, PF 0.87, t -0.47 (results/meanrev/report.md).
- Published: Dao, McGroarty and Urquhart 2016. The team could read only the abstract.
- The lab's earlier FX edges were 1-2 bp intraday. This is the only FX idea with room against the cost.

JUDGE'S CHANGE, made before any run: the main exit is Monday 16:00 NY instead of Wednesday 12:00. It crosses no rollover, so there is no swap, and it carries about 1.8x less noise if the reversal comes as Tokyo, London and New York liquidity arrives. The team's exits stay as neighbours.

POWER: about 20 % of a top-quartile weekend move must revert by the exit.
judge_frozen.rule:
CLOCK: New York, DST-aware (FP server = NY + 7 h).

PAIRS: eurusd, gbpusd, usdjpy, audusd, usdcad, usdchf, nzdusd, eurjpy, judged as one basket.

SIGNAL:
- F = mid at the open of the first M1 bar at or after Friday 16:50 NY.
- Decision time D = Sunday 20:00 NY (Monday 03:00 server).
- P = mid at the open of the first M1 bar at or after D; skip the pair if there is none within 15 min.
- sigma = sd of the pair's last 60 daily log returns (days ending 17:00 NY).
- z = ln(P/F)/sigma.
- Signal when |z| >= the 75th percentile of the pair's |z| over its previous 104 weekends (at least 52 required).
- Side = -sign(z): fade the weekend move.

ENTRY: market at D.
STOP: 1.0 x ATR(20) of daily bars, from the fill.
EXIT: market at Monday 16:00 NY, before the 17:00 NY rollover, so no swap.

SIZING: 1 R = stop distance; equal R per pair; one position per pair. Every signal is evaluated; the robot's position cap is applied afterwards.
judge_frozen.instruments: eurusd, gbpusd, usdjpy, audusd, usdcad, usdchf, nzdusd, eurjpy: FP Raw, frames lab/data/fp/*_m1.parquet, 2013-2021 (trades from 2014 after the 52-weekend warm-up).
judge_frozen.test_plan:
11 configurations. The verdict is read on (1) only.

(1) Main: threshold P75 of |z|; decision Sunday 20:00 NY; exit Monday 16:00 NY; stop 1.0 x ATR(20).

Neighbours:
(2) threshold P65
(3) threshold P85
(4) decision 19:00 NY
(5) decision 21:00 NY
(6) exit Tuesday 12:00 NY
(7) exit Wednesday 12:00 NY (the team's original main)
(8) stop 0.75 x ATR(20)
(9) stop 1.5 x ATR(20)

Stress: (10) main at costs x1.5.

Null: (11) 200 replays at the same Sunday clock time on randomly drawn weekends, with the same pair, side, stop and holding time, pooled.

COST: FP Raw frames: spread with the 6 USD/lot commission folded in (0.64-1.92 bp), Dukascopy's Sunday-evening spread shape, market slippage 0.1 bp per side, stop 0.3 bp (r2/fp_costs.json). Swaps on the paying side only in (6) and (7).

PASS = PROTOCOL_V3 s.4 basket bars:
- t on daily (Monday) sums >= 2.5;
- pooled PF >= 1.12, and >= 1.04 at x1.5;
- >= 60 % of years positive;
- >= 6 of 8 pairs positive;
- no pair above 25 % of the profit;
- neighbours' median PF >= 1.06;
- every-signal expectancy > 0;
- null >= 97.5th percentile.

PRE-CHECKS (not trials):
- for each pair, the share of 2014-2021 weekends with an M1 bar within 15 minutes of Sunday 20:00 NY; below 90 % the pair is dropped before the run;
- frame spread at Sunday 20:00 NY against a weekday 20:00.

REPORTED: split by USD side; weekends with |z| >= 1.5 against the rest; mean path of the main's trades at 22:00, 03:00, 08:00 and 16:00 NY (the mechanism).

BEFORE ANY VAL LOOK: read FP's Sunday 20:00 NY spreads in MT5. If they exceed 2x the frame's, recompute the in-sample row at that cost; it must still pass.

Expected n about 830; VAL about 400. If this passes in sample, the version on emerging-market USD pairs is the next test.

verdict_read_on: configuration 1 only; 2-9 neighbours, 10 cost stress, 11 random-entry null
criteria_main: >= 6 of 8 pairs positive (65 % of the pairs kept)
no pair above 25 % of the profit

readings_of_open_details.data: Frames lab/data/fp/<pair>_m1.parquet only, read with the pyarrow row filter ts < 2022-01-01 00:00 UTC before anything else; that slice is passed explicitly to every function and simulation (never goldlab.r2.load / r2.run / r2.null_test, which read the full frame). Trades are kept only with entry < 2022-01-01; the last decision Sunday is 2021-12-26 and its latest exit (Wednesday 2021-12-29 12:00 NY) is inside the slice. Official trades of the ten are read with the filter entry_time < 2022-01-01 in the same statement.
readings_of_open_details.clock: America/New_York from the tz database (DST-aware). Decision Sundays: every calendar Sunday of the slice.
readings_of_open_details.F: mid = (bid open + ask open)/2 of the first M1 bar whose start is in [Friday 16:50, Friday 17:05) NY, the Friday two days before the decision Sunday. The text gives no tolerance for F; the 15-minute tolerance it gives for P is applied, and a pair with no such bar (holiday Fridays, gaps) is skipped that weekend -- never a later bar.
readings_of_open_details.P: mid of the open of the first M1 bar whose start is in [D, D + 15 min); none -> the pair is skipped that weekend.
readings_of_open_details.entry: The decision uses the OPEN of the P bar, i.e. that bar is not closed when P is known. To keep decisions on closed information only (task rule 3) the market order is filled at the open of the NEXT M1 bar (one minute later in normal data), never on the tick that defines P. That bar must start no later than D + 15 min, else the pair is skipped that weekend. Long fills at the ask, short at the bid, plus 0.1 bp market slippage.
readings_of_open_details.sigma: Sample sd (ddof 1) of the last 60 log returns of daily MID closes, daily bars = the lab's trading days ending 17:00 NY built by goldlab.full_days (days with at least 600 M1 bars; holiday stubs dropped), using only days complete at D (t_close <= D): the last return ends at Friday's 17:00 close. Fewer than 60 returns -> no z.
readings_of_open_details.z: z = ln(P/F) / sigma; z = 0 -> no signal.
readings_of_open_details.threshold: numpy.percentile (linear interpolation) at q of the pair's |z| over its previous 104 weekends that HAVE a z (the current weekend excluded), at least 52 such values, else no decision (warm-up). Each configuration uses the |z| history of its own decision clock (19:00 / 20:00 / 21:00). Signal when |z| >= that value.
readings_of_open_details.atr: ATR(20) = goldlab.atr (Wilder, alpha 1/20, mid true range) on the same full daily bars, value of the last day complete at D (Friday). Stop distance = stop_atr x ATR(20), from the fill, fixed (no trailing, no target).
readings_of_open_details.broker_min_stop: A trade whose stop distance is below 3 x the spread of its entry bar (ask open - bid open of the frame used, i.e. the widened spread in the x1.5 run) is refused (not taken) and counted.
readings_of_open_details.exit: Market at the open of the first M1 bar at or after Monday 16:00 NY (Tuesday 12:00 / Wednesday 12:00 in (6)/(7)) via goldlab.exit_index (if that time falls in a closure of more than 30 min, the last bar before it). Exit bar must be after the entry bar. Stops are resting orders filled by the lab simulator (stop slippage 0.3 bp; gap -> worse of stop/open; stop assumed hit inside a bar that touches it).
readings_of_open_details.costs: FP frames (FP Raw spread with the 6 USD/lot commission folded in, Dukascopy's intraday spread shape including Sunday evening, clipped 0.7x-6x the trading day's median) + goldlab.r2.costs(pair): market slippage 0.1 bp/side, stop 0.3 bp, swaps of r2/fp_costs.json on the paying side only (credits ignored), Wednesday triple; the simulator charges one swap per 17:00 NY rollover crossed: none for exits on Monday 16:00, 1 night for Tuesday 12:00, 2 for Wednesday 12:00.
readings_of_open_details.stress: (10) = main with spread x1.5 around the mid and both slippages x1.5 (goldlab.r2 'stress' mode: orders rebuilt on the widened quotes; mids and signals unchanged).
readings_of_open_details.positions: One position per pair (simulate no_overlap=True per pair; the rule cannot overlap itself: one decision per pair per weekend, exits before the next Friday). The every-signal run (no_overlap=False) is computed for the main. No cap across pairs ('the robot's position cap is applied afterwards').
readings_of_open_details.basket_stats: Pooled over the pairs kept after the pre-check. t on daily sums = t of the sums of R per trading day of ENTRY (all entries of a weekend fall on its Monday trading day), days with at least one trade. PF on R. Years by calendar year of entry (UTC). Pair positive = pair expectancy in R > 0. Pair share = pair total R / pooled total R (fails if the pooled total is not positive). R = net pnl / initial stop distance (1 R per trade, equal R per pair).
readings_of_open_details.criteria: Judge's PASS list for the main configuration, plus the single-sleeve bars of PROTOCOL_V3 s.4 / PROTOCOL_V2 s.4 that the basket text does not replace (n >= 250, max hold <= 5 trading days): all must hold.
readings_of_open_details.neighbours_median: Median of the pooled PF (FP costs) of configurations (2)-(9) (8 values).
readings_of_open_details.null: (11): for each of the main's trades, 200 times: a weekend drawn at random (uniform, with replacement, seeded) among that pair's decision weekends of the main (weekends after the 52-value warm-up whose P bar and entry bar exist), re-entered at the same Sunday clock exactly as the rule enters (open of the bar after the first bar at or after 20:00 NY), same pair, same side, same stop as a fraction of price (scaled to the replay's entry mid), same holding time (exit at the same Monday 16:00 NY clock via goldlab.exit_index), FP costs, every replayed trade simulated (no_overlap=False); the statistic is the pooled mean R of each replay; pass if the main's mean R is above at least 97.5 % of the 200 replay means.
readings_of_open_details.precheck: Not trials. (a) For each pair, share of the calendar Sundays 2014-01-05 .. 2021-12-26 with an M1 bar starting in [20:00, 20:15) NY; below 90 % the pair is dropped before the run. (b) Median frame spread (ask open - bid open, in bp of mid) of the bar starting at 20:00 NY on Sundays against Monday-Thursday, 2014-2021.
readings_of_open_details.reported_information: From the main's trades only (no new configuration): split by USD side (long USD / short USD / cross eurjpy); |z| >= 1.5 against the rest; mean path at Sunday 22:00, Monday 03:00, 08:00 and 16:00 NY (unstopped mid move in the trade's direction in bp and R, and the share already stopped); net result split into gross move and cost paid per trade (accounting of the same trades, not a re-simulation); weekly correlation (sums of R per exit week, every calendar week 2014-01 .. 2021-12) with the sum of the ten and with each cluster (us100: noise30 + ocm4; gold: GOLD_FRI_PM + donch4h_stop + orb_asia_2d_buf10; crypto: brk72_24h_wd btc + eth, F1_brk_ridge_filter btc + eth, nq_btc_follow), the main's weekly Sharpe and the change of the ten's weekly Sharpe when it is added at 1 R.
readings_of_open_details.causality: Truncation test on at least 50 decisions: the decision quantities (F, P, sigma, z, threshold, side, ATR, stop distance, P-bar time) recomputed on a frame cut just after the P bar, with that bar's high, low and close blanked (only its open survives), must equal the full-frame ones; plus orders rebuilt on frames cut at random times must equal the full-frame orders decided before the cut.
readings_of_open_details.mt5_sunday_spread: The judge's 'BEFORE ANY VAL LOOK' condition (FP's Sunday 20:00 NY spreads read in MT5; if above 2x the frame's, recompute the in-sample row) needs the user's MT5: it cannot be read here and is reported as pending.
